-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
-- Boolean results are three-valued: JBool(true), JBool(false), or JNull (UNKNOWN).
-- WHERE, HAVING, and ON keep a row only when the predicate is exactly TRUE.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, any, length, sum)

-- Compares two non-null values of the same type.
pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool = not(is_null(j)) && not(truth(j))

fn first_non_null(vs : List(Json)) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      if is_null(v) then
        first_non_null(rest)
      else
        v

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      -- Every aggregate other than COUNT(*) ignores NULL inputs.
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_non_null(map(\(a) -> evaluate(a, row, group), e.args))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        -- Arithmetic and ordinary comparison propagate NULL.
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

-- Bottom-up simplification. Literal-only subtrees are evaluated with the same
-- three-valued semantics as execution, so NULL = NULL folds to NULL rather than
-- TRUE. IS [NOT] NULL and COALESCE are additionally simplified using the
-- nullability bound computed by the binder, which already includes the NULL
-- padding introduced by LEFT JOIN. Expressions over columns such as x = x or
-- p OR NOT p are never folded because they are UNKNOWN on NULL input.
pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  elif n.op == "ISNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(false))
  elif n.op == "ISNOTNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(true))
  elif n.op == "COALESCE" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    at(n.args, 0)
  else
    n

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn is_true_literal(e : Expr) : Bool = e.op == "lit" && truth(e.value)

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match filter(\(e) -> not(is_true_literal(e)), es) of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

fn single_source(e : Expr) : Int =
  let ss = sources(e)
  if length(ss) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss) then
    at(ss, 0)
  else
    -1

-- A predicate over one source is null-rejecting when it cannot be TRUE on a
-- row whose columns from that source are all NULL, i.e. on a padded row.
fn null_rejecting(e : Expr, width : Int) : Bool =
  not(truth(evaluate(e, replicate(width, JNull), [])))

-- Push a WHERE conjunct into a scan only when every referenced slot belongs
-- to one join input and the move is sound:
--   * an inner-join input, or the preserved (left) side of a left join: the
--     join keeps or pads every left row, so filtering it first is equivalent;
--   * the padded (right) side of a left join: only if the conjunct is
--     null-rejecting. Then padded rows could never pass WHERE, so the join is
--     first rewritten to an INNER JOIN, after which the push is legal.
-- Other conjuncts, including multi-source ones, remain above the joins.
-- Slot numbers remain global; scan predicates receive a prefix padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let width = sum(map(\(t) -> length(t.columns), plan.tables))
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  var outer := q.outer
  var fs := map(\(_) -> [], plan.tables)
  var rem := []
  for e in sof(terms) do
    let s = single_source(e)
    let padded = s > 0 && at(outer, s - 1)
    if s >= 0 && length(plan.tables) > 1 && (not(padded) || null_rejecting(e, width)) then
      if padded then
        outer := map(\(i) -> at(outer, i) && i /= s - 1, range(0, length(outer)))
      fs := map(\(i) -> if i == s then append(at(fs, i), [e]) else at(fs, i), range(0, length(fs)))
    else
      rem := append(rem, [e])
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    outer = outer,
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_one(
  l : List(Json),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let matches = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right))
  if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
    [append(l, replicate(width, JNull))]
  else
    matches

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) -> join_one(l, right, on, outer, width), left))

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

-- Keys are compared by their JSON encoding, so NULL equals NULL per position.
fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

fn compare_ordered(a : Json, b : Json, desc : Bool, nulls_first : Bool) : Int =
  if is_null(a) && is_null(b) then
    0
  elif is_null(a) then
    if nulls_first then -1 else 1
  elif is_null(b) then
    if nulls_first then 1 else -1
  else
    let c = compare_value(a, b)
    if desc then -c else c

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls_first), rest) =>
      let c = compare_ordered(at(a, i), at(b, i), desc, nulls_first)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      else
        c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    let width = length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns)
    rows := join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i), at(q.outer, i), width)
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

-- SQL NULL is represented by JNull throughout evaluation; a boolean
-- expression therefore yields JBool(true), JBool(false), or JNull (UNKNOWN).
pub fn is_null(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

-- "null" is the type of an untyped NULL literal; it unifies with any type.
pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

-- `nullable` is a static upper bound: false means the expression can never
-- evaluate to NULL (it accounts for declared nullability and outer-join padding).
pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    nullable = true,
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v), nullable = is_null(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

-- `outer` holds one flag per join: true for LEFT OUTER JOIN, false for INNER.
-- `order` entries are (alias, descending, nulls_first).
pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  outer: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Bool)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Bool))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      let c = at(cs, i)
      let v = at(row, i)
      demand(value_type(v) == c.kind || is_null(v) && c.nullable, "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable =
    match getfield(j, "nullable") of
      JBool(b) => b
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_INPUT")
        false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    nullable = nullable,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

defs.name: fits
defs.source: fn fits(kind : String, t : String) : Bool = kind == t || kind == "null"

defs.name: check
defs.source:
fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind, nullable = c.nullable }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let typed = filter(\(t) -> t /= "null", ts)
    let common = if length(typed) > 0 then at(typed, 0) else "null"
    let agree = all(\(t) -> t == common, typed)
    let anynull = any(\(a) -> a.nullable, args)
    let (kind, nullable) =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        ("int", false)
      elif e.op == "SUM" then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "int"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("int", true)
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        (at(ts, 0), true)
      elif elem(e.op, ["+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "int"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("int", anynull)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> fits(t, "bool"), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("bool", anynull)
      elif elem(e.op, ["ISNULL", "ISNOTNULL"]) then
        ("bool", false)
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        demand(agree, "TYPE_ERROR")
        (common, all(\(a) -> a.nullable, args))
      else
        demand(agree && (common /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])), "TYPE_ERROR")
        ("bool", anynull)
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind, nullable = nullable }

defs.name: predicate
tree_any
defs.source:
fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

defs.name: find_table
bind
alias_index
defs.source:
fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

defs.name: compare_value
defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

defs.name: is_false
defs.source: fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool = not(is_null(j)) && not(truth(j))

defs.name: first_non_null
defs.source:
fn first_non_null(vs : List(Json)) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      if is_null(v) then
        first_non_null(rest)
      else
        v

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      -- Every aggregate other than COUNT(*) ignores NULL inputs.
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    first_non_null(map(\(a) -> evaluate(a, row, group), e.args))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then
        JNull
      else
        JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
          JBool(false)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then
          JBool(true)
        elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
          JNull
        else
          JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        -- Arithmetic and ordinary comparison propagate NULL.
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

defs.name: extremum
defs.source:
fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

defs.name: fold_constants
defs.source:
fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  elif n.op == "ISNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(false))
  elif n.op == "ISNOTNULL" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    literal(JBool(true))
  elif n.op == "COALESCE" && not(at(n.args, 0).nullable) then
    at(n.args, 0)
  else
    n

fn join_one(
  l : List(Json),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let matches = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right))
  if outer && length(matches) == 0 then
    [append(l, replicate(width, JNull))]
  else
    matches

defs.name: add_group
defs.source:
fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

defs.name: groups_for
defs.source:
fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

defs.name: compare_ordered
defs.source:
fn compare_ordered(a : Json, b : Json, desc : Bool, nulls_first : Bool) : Int =
  if is_null(a) && is_null(b) then
    0
  elif is_null(a) then
    if nulls_first then -1 else 1
  elif is_null(b) then
    if nulls_first then 1 else -1
  else
    let c = compare_value(a, b)
    if desc then -c else c

defs.name: row_compare
defs.source:
fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nulls_first), rest) =>
      let c = compare_ordered(at(a, i), at(b, i), desc, nulls_first)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      else
        c

defs.name: insert_row
defs.source:
fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

defs.name: sort_rows

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

defs.name: scan_string

fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

fn scan_word(s : String, i : Int, numbers : Bool) : Int =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn precedence(op : String) : Int =
  if op == "OR" then
    1
  elif op == "AND" then
    2
  elif elem(op, ["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">=", "IS"]) then
    4
  elif elem(op, ["+", "-"]) then

  elif op == "*" then

  else

defs.name: arguments
expression
defs.source:
fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = arguments()
      expect(")")
      demand(length(args) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      node(w, args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js, os) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    outer = os,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }
